question: Has the repeated O-chain entered a higher fixed-grammar regime, and what would be required before treating that regime itself as a new higher algebraic object?

terminology.grammar_plateau: Consecutive material levels normalize to the same carrier/action/read-write/quotient grammar, and a conditional theorem recursively transports that grammar.
terminology.type_fixed_point: A single carrier type X with a proved self-equivalence X ~= Lift(X) or equivalent depth-erasing representation. This is stronger than grammar repetition.
terminology.meta_service_quotient: An observer-relative quotient of depth-indexed O carriers that preserves a named collective service and compresses repeated depth without reopening microscopic carriers.
terminology.raised_O_group: Descriptive name only until a meta-service quotient and exact meta-composition/substitution theorem are earned.

gates.name: normalized_grammar_plateau
gates.criterion: same normalized grammar on consecutive historical/material O-level evidence

gates.name: material_instances
gates.criterion: consecutive actual constructed/certified witnesses beyond the theorem anchor

gates.name: carrier_type_fixed_point
gates.criterion: depth-erasing carrier equivalence or self-similar carrier theorem

gates.name: depth_independent_service_quotient
gates.criterion: stable exact collective-service quotient across depth with separators for all merges/splits

gates.name: meta_composition_substitution
gates.criterion: composition on service objects is exact and substitutive in admitted contexts

gates.name: meta_full_abstraction_minimality
gates.criterion: for a frozen meta-observer/action language, quotient is fully abstract/minimal or equivalent exact claim
